ap-pingo (adp- , Baiter, K. and H.), ĕre, v. a.,
I.to paint upon something (very rare): Delphinum silvis adpingit, fluctibus aprum, * Hor. A. P. 30: “colorem vetusculum,” Front. Or. 1, p. 229 ; 2, p. 257; Laud. Neglig. 2, 371.—In Cic. in epistolary style, also of writing, to add by writing, to
write: “adpinge aliquid novi,” Cic. Att. 2, 8, 2 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
